access_review.summary: Partner lets you choose two commanders if both have partner and can be your commander. Each keeps its own colors and abilities; the pair does not change either card’s colors.

W.note: Akroma, Vision of Ixidor: Has partner; each combat, her bonus to your other creatures also counts whether they have partner among her listed abilities.

Sidar Kondo of Jamuraa: Has partner and flanking. Opposing creatures without flying or reach cannot block creatures with power 2 or less.
Silas Renn, Seeker Adept: Has partner and deathtouch. Dealing combat damage to a player lets you target an artifact card in your graveyard and cast it that turn.
Kraum, Ludevic's Opus: Has partner, flying and haste. You draw a card whenever an opponent casts their second spell that turn.
Kydele, Chosen of Kruphix: Has partner; tapping her adds {C} for each card you have drawn this turn.
Vial Smasher the Fierce: Has partner. Your first spell each turn causes damage equal to its mana value to a randomly chosen opponent or a planeswalker that player controls.
